answers.what: It’s a free add-on called deeper for AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.
answers.does: It rewrites a simple request into a more detailed, expert-style one, including what to start with, which tools to use, and how to check the result. It shows you the rewritten request for approval before the AI starts.
answers.who: It seems aimed at ordinary AI users who want better, safer, and more thorough answers without knowing how an expert would phrase the request.
answers.next: Go to deeper.tools, copy the add-on, paste it into your AI assistant, then type “/deeper” before your request. The video does not show the exact copying or installation steps.
